news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.03 (vs ₹0.013 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.03 (up from ₹0.013 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹63.0m (down 62% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹7.56m (up ₹10.9m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 12% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 89% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 18% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 4 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 4 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. news.title: New major risk - Revenue size
news.body: The company makes less than US$1m in revenue. Total revenue: ₹57m (US$631k) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small amount of revenue are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.002 (vs ₹0.021 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.002 (up from ₹0.021 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹6.99m (down 86% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹436.0k (up ₹5.82m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 6.2% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 90% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 14% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
